DICOM image decoders used by dicom-extract.html (loaded only when a series needs them).

openjpegwasm_decode.*      JPEG 2000          @cornerstonejs/codec-openjpeg 1.3.6 (MIT; OpenJPEG BSD-2)
openjphjs.*                HTJ2K              @cornerstonejs/codec-openjph 2.4.11 (MIT; OpenJPH BSD-2)
charlswasm_decode.*        JPEG-LS            @cornerstonejs/codec-charls 1.2.7 (MIT; CharLS BSD-3)
libjpegturbowasm_decode.*  JPEG baseline 8-bit @cornerstonejs/codec-libjpeg-turbo-8bit 1.2.8 (ISC; libjpeg-turbo IJG/BSD)
lossless-min.js            JPEG lossless      jpeg-lossless-decoder-js 2.1.2 (MIT)
RLE Lossless, deflate and big-endian are handled inside dicom-extract.html.
